description: We are the official team of Bill Hogarth Secondary School in Markham, ON. Formed in collaboration with the Bill Hogarth Competitive Programming Club.
summary: We created a text-based game to help youth understand the decisions made in spaceflight. The player controls a Martian outpost, and must balance the various demands of systems in order to ensure mission success. For example, the player must weigh the risks of an astronaut injury during each surface excursion, or decide between two different types of power generation. Through this, players learn and understand what concessions must be made in space exploration in order to balance safety and mission success with scientific discovery.
details:
We used Python and our custom game engine CEJBSBDSL.

This allowed for ease of development for our intended text-based decision making game design. This minimalist design allows the user to focus on what matter most, the decisions at hand, rather than flashy graphics and imagery.
